messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — Novus (trial cohort) still has 2/5 seats activated; onboarding survey shows missing API credentials and the data-mapping section unanswered. I'm worried this stalls their use and creates renewal risk if they don't see value by next month.
Sam: Do we have the exact survey items missing? can you paste?
Maya: Copied the relevant section: 
```
Onboarding survey: 
- Data source type: (blank)
- API host: (blank)
- Sample schema: (blank)
- Primary integration owner: jane@novus.com
```

Maya: They asked if we can support a custom CSV->embedding pipeline — sounds like they want quick ingest before we flip the connector.
Toni: Noted. I can flag them as "high-touch" in the cohort sheet and push an enablement invite. What's their timezone?
Maya: Novus is PST (San Francisco). Lead is Jane. She mentioned availability next Tue/Wed mornings.
Leo: For CSV->embedding we can provision a temporary mapping job. It'll need 1 engineer ~4-6 hours to validate schema and a small ETL script. If CS wants me to pair, I can do a half-day next Wed morning.
Sam: OK — let's do a small plan: 1) schedule 30m pre-call to gather sample files, 2) engineer mapping (Leo), 3) enablement session showing results + guidance.
Maya: I'll draft the invite. Toni can you set the customer tag + triage reason to "survey incomplete / connector help"?
Toni: Done — tag added and a Trello card created: https://trello.com/c/novus-onboard-3234 (private). Setting reminder for follow-up in 48h.
CalBot: Meeting suggestion created: "Novus onboarding: sample file review" Tue 09:30 PST — awaiting acceptance from jane@novus.com :calendar:
Sam: If jane doesn't accept by EOD tomorrow, we escalate to AE for a quick nudge. Who owns AE?
Maya: AE = Priya on this account. Priya out today but back tomorrow. I'll ping her.
Leo: One ask for the pre-call — ask them to attach a small sample CSV (<= 10 rows) and a brief data dictionary. That reduces mapping time a lot.
Maya: I'll include that in the invite. Also adding a short pre-call checklist: 
- sample CSV attached
- desired search fields noted
- primary owner on the call

Sam: Sounds good. Could we also log this as a potential renewal risk (low-medium) until we see activation bump? Helps CS leadership track.
Toni: Marked renewal risk = "medium" in the cohort tracker and set a follow-up milestone for 2 weeks post-enablement.
Maya: Thanks team. Will update this thread after the pre-call. :thumbsup:
